model.len_0: (rrmxmx(seed ^ (secret[64:72] ^ secret[72:80])), rrmxmx(seed ^ (secret[80:88] ^ secret[88:96]))). 128bits returns the folded constants (0x6001c324468d497f, 0x99aa06d3014798d8); withSeed folds the word xors into the immediates 0x682e908a3037f8b4 and 0x9655d30bd1a77d49
model.len_17_to_128: Two mix16B accumulators sweep the windows from the largest inward (input+48/secret+96 with input+len-64/secret+112, then input+32/secret+64 with input+len-48/secret+80, then input+16/secret+32 with input+len-32/secret+48), each step folding the pair into (acc, acc2) with the input-word sums xored in; the trailing mix16B pair is input+0/secret+0 and input+len-16/secret+16. low64 = XXH3_avalanche(A + B), high64 = -XXH3_avalanche(A * PRIME64_1 + B * PRIME64_4 + (len - seed) * PRIME64_2). The (len - seed) term is what the withSeed body computes (rsi = len - seed at 0x61df1b5); 128bits uses len. Every mix16B immediate is a raw kSecret word (offsets 0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72, 80, 88, 96, 104, 112, 120)
model.len_1_to_3: combinedl = data[len-1] | data[0]<<16 | len<<8 | data[len>>1]<<24; combinedh = rotl32(bswap32(combinedl), 13); bitflipl = (read32(secret) ^ read32(secret+4)) + seed; bitfliph = (read32(secret+8) ^ read32(secret+12)) - seed; (rrmxmx(combinedl ^ bitflipl), rrmxmx(combinedh ^ bitfliph)). withSeed folds the word xors into the immediates 0x87275a9b and 0x302c208b
model.len_4_to_8: seed_t = seed ^ (swap32(seed as u32) << 32); input64 = read32(data) + (read32(data+len-4) << 32); bitflip = (read64(secret+16) ^ read64(secret+24)) + seed_t; (lo, hi) = mult128(input64 ^ bitflip, PRIME64_1 + (len<<2)); hi += lo<<1; lo ^= hi>>3; lo = xorshift(lo,35) * 0x9FB21C651E98DF25 xorshifted by 28; hi = XXH3_avalanche(hi). The input64 packing (first word low, last word high) is the public packing and is the opposite of the 64-bit len_4to8 branch; it was corrected after the system oracle disagreed on lengths 5..8, and the corrected model agrees with the oracle on 3,000 cases
model.len_9_to_16: bitflipl = (secret[32:40] ^ secret[40:48]) - seed; bitfliph = (secret[48:56] ^ secret[56:64]) + seed; A = read64(data) ^ read64(data+len-8) ^ bitflipl; (lo1, hi1) = mult128(A, PRIME64_1); C = (u32(read64(data+len-8) ^ bitfliph) * 0x85EBCA76) + (read64(data+len-8) ^ bitfliph) + hi1; low2 = (lo1 + ((len-1)<<54)) ^ bswap64(C); (lo2, hi2) = mult128(low2, PRIME64_2); D = C * PRIME64_2 + hi2; (XXH3_avalanche(lo2), XXH3_avalanche(D)). withSeed folds the word xors into the immediates 0x59973f0033362349 (- seed) and 0xc202797692d63d58 (+ seed)

return_value: 128-bit hash as (low64, high64) in (%rax, %rdx). The Hash2x64 wrappers store high64 through their first out-pointer argument and low64 through the second

semantics.packing_note: The 128-bit len-4..8 input64 packing (first word low, last word high) is the opposite of the 64-bit len_4to8 branch packing; both were confirmed against their own disassembly and against the system xxHash oracle
semantics.scope: Lengths 0..128 only, both entry points. The 129..240 and >240 branches are recorded in branches.tsv with their dispatch sites and delegation targets (len_129to240 at 0x61d80a0, hashLong at 0x61d8a60 / 0x61d9bc0) and are out of scope for this packet
semantics.seed_term: Only the len-4..8 branch transforms the seed (swap32 of the low word into the high word, xored with the seed), and only the 17..128 final uses (len - seed). All other branches add or subtract the seed directly on the secret-word xors

side_effects: Neither function writes memory, calls out (except the stack-canary failure path to __stack_chk_fail), or reads outside [data, data+len) and the secret windows listed in the model. The stack canary is checked on the 128bits return paths

tests.cases: 2,400 deterministic cases (1,200 per entry point; lengths 0..128 cycled; withSeed over 12 seeds including 0, 1, 2, PRIME64_1 and 0xffffffffffffffff). Transliteration vs independent public-formula reference: 0 mismatches. See result.json
tests.oracle_check: During development the transliteration was additionally checked against the system libxxhash 0.8.2 oracle (3,000 random cases, lengths 0..128, 8 seeds, 0 mismatches); the oracle is not an input to the generator
tests.published_anchors: XXH3_128bits(b'', 0) = (0x6001c324468d497f, 0x99aa06d3014798d8) holds through both entry points (default secret / seed 0)
